trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: The author uses an unreliable narrator in The Remains of the Day, for example.
trap.right: The author uses an unreliable narrator, as in The Remains of the Day.
trap.why: Português “por exemplo” vira for example no fim; para nomear técnica + obra, use as in + obra.

opts: …as in The Remains of the Day.
…like in The Remains of the Day.

fix.wrong: Like in the novel, he lies.
fix.right: As in the novel, he lies.

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “The author uses an unreliable narrator.”
rewrite.answer: The author used an unreliable narrator.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com as in: “For example, in the novel he lies.”
rewrite.answer: As in the novel, he lies.
A device is used by the author.
